digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport retry layer
propositions: 429 responses from Jira Data Center rate limiting are not retried, causing hard failures on rate-limited instances
Retry-After header is not parsed or honoured when present in 429 responses from DC token bucket
The retry mechanism must be scoped to idempotent reads only to prevent duplicate writes from retrying mutations after partial server acceptance

Four high-volume read call sites (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map paged search, get_comment_map per-issue fetch, get_parent_map) require opt-in retry-on-429 with Retry-After header parsing and up-to-20-percent jitter applied

The rate-limit-retry flag must route through both _call_logged (PATH A for paged searches) and direct _with_connection_retry calls (PATH B for per-issue comment fetches) to reach all idempotent read sites
All mutation call sites must continue to fail immediately on first 429 without retry to prevent duplicate issue/comment creation
